Does Brad Pitt die in thirtysomething?

No. The babysitter's boyfriend, alive and glowing.

Pitt plays Bernard, the boyfriend of the Steadmans' babysitter, in a brief love scene in the season three episode "Love and Sex". Producers said he caused a stir on set. Nothing bad happens to him.
